name: FAQ — Voyantra
html:
More questions?

Is the Starter plan enough for my team?

Our travel inventory, 24/7 trip support, and unified spend tracking alone are enough for some small teams. But to use advanced reporting, embed Voyantra directly into your workflows, or manage more than one travel policy or budget, you'll want Premium or Pro.

Can I have multiple travel policies on the Starter plan?

Starter is built around a single, company-wide policy. If different teams or regions need their own rules, Premium and Pro support multiple policies and budgets at once.

What counts as extensive inventory?

Flights, rail, hotels, and cars from every major supplier we can negotiate rates with, plus alternative stays like serviced apartments on Premium and Pro.

How does my company get billed?

One monthly invoice covering every trip booked that month, itemised by traveler and cost center, with no charge at all for months nobody travels.
